title: Eight products race for revenue
description: eight products racing on revenue, 2019 to 2026 · tone follows rank so the leader is always ink · plays through once on view, click to replay

props.name: data
props.description: Ordered period frames, each with one nonnegative finite revenue value in thousands per product. Null is unavailable; incomplete frame arrays suppress that frame. Playback runs once and holds the final frame.

props.name: products
props.description: Stable unique product IDs and caller display names, in the same column order as every frame. Repeated display names are supported.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total component height in pixels; otherwise retains the original plot proportions.

props.name: width
props.description: Optional fixed width in pixels; otherwise fills its containing element.

props.name: animate
props.description: Enable token-timed motion subject to the system reduced-motion preference.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the component container.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible description of what this instance measures.
